title: Lantern Thirty-Seven | Nat 20 Pixels C1E1
description:
The oldest lantern road in the Vael has burned for three hundred years. Tonight, one of its lanterns goes out.
Four strangers in a frontier village - a soldier, a scholar, a card sharp and a young priest - are about to find out what comes up the road in the dark.

Episode 1 of a daily pixel-art Dungeons & Dragons story. Every check, attack and spell is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen: no rerolls, no fudging. Meet Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel at level 1; the story follows them to level 20.

New episode every weekday. Lore, characters and every roll are on the wiki.
